nodes.text:
HMPV primarily affects children, causing symptoms akin to the common cold, flu, or even #COVID19. Hospitals, especially in northern provinces, are seeing an influx of pediatric patients.

With no vaccine or specific treatment for HMPV, the focus is on preventive measures. Masks, hand washing, and avoiding contact with sick individuals are recommended.

(2/3)
